label: The MIRROR_2 image of the actual world satisfies every ESSENCE_5 truth the actual world does
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: orientation-free natures under CPT conjugation (MIRROR_2), at w only. For every being x and world-proposition φ, if it lies in the nature of x that φ and φ holds at w, then φ holds at the CPT image τ.image w. No nature contains a condition that the actual arrangement meets and its CPT image violates. Under essence grounding necessity at w, world-level essence-grounded possibility and factivity it is equivalent to the accessibility of the CPT image (Lean-only pres_iff_mirrorPossible at τ.image, certificate clause 9), so its warrant is exactly the warrant for 'the CPT-mirror world is possible'. Local Lorentz-invariant quantum field theory is invariant under CPT (physics background, navigation only), so creaturely law-natures give no violation. The MIRROR_1 counterpart (spatial reflection P) is not recorded as a statement and no argument uses it: on dispositional essentialism it is doubtful, since the weak interaction is not reflection-invariant and the P-image violates law-grounding natures of creaturely kinds (option 1 at a creature). A nature containing a primitive orientation, or an essential truth about which of two incongruent counterparts is realized, denies it. It says nothing about natures at other worlds.
